title: Necromancer with Spell Book
description: A dark surreal illustration of a hooded necromancer figure with large round goggles and a golden halo-like crown, sitting atop a massive pile of skulls and bones. The figure holds an open spell book in one hand while raising the other hand, casting a swirling vortex of magical energy and orbs, with three potion bottles floating above and ghostly figures visible in the background near a dark castle silhouette.
